transkript.t: Wait, I didn't make Google Anti-Gravity way more powerful with just four tools?
Yes. And each one solves a different problem in your development workflow.
Okay, what's the first one?
Get shit done. It breaks big features into smaller phases,
helping you plan, execute, and verify instead of tackling everything at once.
So no more asking AI to build my entire app in one shot.
Exactly. You get a more structured workflow.
Nice. What's next?
RUCODE. It supports multiple AI models, giving you flexibility to choose or
switch models based on your needs.
So I'm not stuck with just one model?
Right. But switching models doesn't mean your entire context automatically transfers.
Got it. What about making agents work longer without babysitting them?
That's where RolfLoop comes in. It repeatedly runs an agent through iterations toward a defined
goal with completion checks and stop conditions.
So it can keep fixing and improving its work?
That's the idea. Just set proper limits because endless loops can waste tokens and money.
And how do I catch bugs before shipping?
CodeRabbit. It reviews your code and flags potential bugs, risky changes,
and security issues before you merge.
So these four cover planning, model flexibility, agent loops, and code review?
Exactly.
Okay, where's the setup guide?
Comment gravity and I'll send you the links.
